```{r narrative_text, include=FALSE}
# Escape special LaTeX characters (%, \$, &) so percentages don't comment out text
escape_tex <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return("")
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("%", "\\%", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("&", "\\&", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("$", "\\$", x, fixed = TRUE)
  return(x)
}


build_narratives <- function(sizex) {
  comparison_data <- chart.data.calc.fn(
    mean.median.calculations(
      yearx = set.year,
      leaidx = select.leaid,
      districtx = select.district,
      statex = select.state,
      sizex = sizex
    )
  )

  list(
    chart1 = escape_tex(chart_1_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district)),
    chart2 = escape_tex(chart_2_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district)),
    chart3 = escape_tex(chart_3_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district)),
    chart4 = escape_tex(chart_4_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district)),
    chart5 = escape_tex(chart_5_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district)),
    chart6 = escape_tex(chart_6_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district))
  )
}

narrative_15k  <- build_narratives(15000)
narrative_50k  <- build_narratives(50000)
narrative_100k <- build_narratives(100000)
```

```{r CGCS_narrative_text, include=FALSE}
build_cgcs_narratives <- function() {
  comparison_data <- chart.data.calc.fn(
    CGCS.mean.median.calculations(
      yearx = set.year,
      leaidx = select.leaid,
      districtx = select.district,
      statex = select.state
    )
  )

  list(
    chart1 = escape_tex(chart_1_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district)),
    chart2 = escape_tex(chart_2_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district)),
    chart3 = escape_tex(chart_3_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district)),
    chart4 = escape_tex(chart_4_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district)),
    chart5 = escape_tex(chart_5_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district)),
    chart6 = escape_tex(chart_6_narrative_fn(comparison_data, select.district))
  )
}

narrative_cgcs <- build_cgcs_narratives()
```

# Introduction

\large
This staffing report is prepared annually by the Council of the Great City Schools using the most recent data available from the \href{https://nces.ed.gov/ccd/files.asp}{National Center for Education Statistics (NCES)} Common Core of Data (CCD) for Public Elementary and Secondary Education. This staffing report summarizes staffing levels and workforce indicators for **`r params$district_name`** in **`r params$state_name`** during the **`r params$full_year_name`** school year, with comparisons to districts of similar enrollment size.

These comparisons help districts benchmark their staffing patterns against other school systems, assess workforce allocation relative to student enrollment, and inform district staffing policies and operational decisions. 

Each staffing report includes six key staffing indicators:

  -	Student-to-Total Staff Ratio
  -	Teachers as a Percentage of Total Staff
  -	Student-to-Teacher Ratio
  -	Students per Central Office Administrative and Support Staff Member
  -	Students per School-Site Administrative and Support Staff Member
  -	Students per Combined Administrative and Support Staff Member (School-Site and Central Office)

```{r appendix-table, results='asis'}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

appendix_cgcs_table <- appendix_cgcs_table %>%
  rename(
    District = District,
    Enrollment = Enrollment,
    `Total Staff` = Total_Staff,
    `Pupil-Teacher` = Pupil_Teacher_Ratio,
    `Pupil-Staff` = Pupil_Total_Staff_Ratio,
    `Pupil-LEA Admin` = Pupil_LEA_Admin_Ratio,
    `Pupil-School Admin` = Pupil_School_Admin_Ratio,
    `Pupil-Total Admin` = Pupil_Total_Admin_Ratio
  )

kable(
  appendix_cgcs_table,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  longtable = TRUE,
  caption = "Staffing Metrics for Council of the Great City Schools Districts"
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("repeat_header", "hold_position"),
    font_size = 8)
```
